criteria.description: Accurately traces normalization, duplicate detection, save-before-publish behavior, and available store operations with file evidence.
Identifies the minimal normalizer, store, router, and contract changes and preserves both audit history and one active contribution.
Explains at least four concrete risks, including save-before-publish inconsistency, replay idempotency, missing targets, trade mismatch, and partial failure.
Proposes focused tests for all required cases without relying on implementation details.
Makes no workspace change, stays under 1,000 words, uses all exact sections, and separates evidence from recommendations.
